text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #10234 is ready but gated on architecture signoff. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-shard-routing. Short summary: routing policy tweak to prefer cached prefixes + a fallback to cheaper model-variant when capacity is low. Canary planned 5% for 24h. @alex can you take a look? I flagged branch protection to require arch-approve before merge.
arjun: Thanks — can you paste the expected SLO delta and the perf numbers that matter?
maria: TL;DR: expected p95 +2ms, p99 worst-case +6–8ms under synthetic 16k-token batching stress. Cost estimate: ~15% unit cost reduction for typical chat workloads due to prefix caching. See RFC section 'latency-model' for full numbers.
sophie: ping @alex — we need a quick safety check. If arch can't review today, can we flip to manual-merge and do a follow-up canary? :thinking_face:
jamie: small comment in the PR about rollout docs missing the explicit abort condition — added a line. Also noted a tiny formatting nit.
alex: I can do an eyeball pass today around 4pm PT. Quick Q: does this change shard affinity/leadership or leader-election semantics? If so SRE needs to be involved.
maria: Not touching leader-election or affinity — only routing policy at request-time. I updated both PR description and RFC to call that out. @eng-sre FYI.
deploy-bot: CI passed. E2E report: https://ci.redwood/10234/flaky-tests (2 flaky tests listed)
arjun: Do we have Dedicated vs Hosted perf split in the RFC? capacity planning will want that.
maria: Yes — I added a benchmark matrix in the RFC appendix. Quick excerpt: Dedicated p99 +6ms, Hosted p99 +4ms under mixed user workloads; numbers vary by batch size and KV cache hit rate.
alex: I skimmed the RFC. Main blocker for me is cache eviction semantics: if prefix cache eviction can cause correctness/regression (rare but possible) we need an explicit test and a clear rollback plan before arch-approve.
maria: Understood. I'll add a focused test for eviction edgecases and a rollback playbook. Local test command I'm adding to PR:
```
pytest tests/test_routing.py::TestPrefixCache -k eviction -q
```
Proposed rollback: flip feature flag + immediate route fallback to model-variant 'v1'.
sophie: If you add that test I'm +1 and can take ownership of rollout docs updates. Happy to sign off on docs so you can get to arch faster.
maria: Thanks — assigning docs ownership to @sophie and I'll drop the test in within the hour.
alex: Great. If the test is present and passes in CI I'll mark arch-approve before EOD. :thumbsup:
jamie: left that tiny formatting suggestion, otherwise LGTM pending arch.
deploy-bot: Note: branch protection rules require the 'arch-approve' label and passing CI before merge is allowed.
maria: Ack — tagging the RFC URL in this thread for traceability and will post a follow-up when tests are in. Thanks all!
